pages.title: Inside a black hole
pages.text: There's no ground. Islands of debris hang over a bottomless dark, under a sky with one thing in it: a $(thing)huge black hole$(), its glowing disc almost edge-on, the stars bent into a ring around it.$(br2)It's dark: bring light.

pages.title: Top to bottom
pages.text: $(thing)Horizon Shallows$() (above about y 260): scattered rubble, pale calcite. Gravity is almost gone.$(br2)$(thing)Debris Drift$() (y 150 to 260): the big islands, with whole patches of torn-off overworld, grass and trees and all.$(br2)$(thing)Tidal Depths$() (y 40 to 150): dark deepslate islands and tall, thin spires stretched toward the bottom. $(item)Neutronium$() is found here.

pages.title: Gravity
pages.text: Gravity changes with height: about a $(num)fifth$() of normal at the top, rising steadily the deeper you go to nearly $(num)twice$() normal at the bottom.$(br2)Falls hurt more down there, and jumps get short. Build upward to be safe.

pages.title: Time
pages.text: Time runs faster in the deep. Below y 150, furnaces cook faster and crops, saplings and anything else that grows on its own grow faster, up to $(num)4x$() from y 60 down.$(br2)It only runs fast near players.

pages.title: The bottom
pages.text: Below y 40 is the $(danger)spaghettification line$(). Past it the singularity drags you down harder and harder and stretches you apart. Nothing that falls in comes back.
